items.bounce: NEW FAILURE CLASS, with the measurement. audit-match-soundness's -Accept verdict gate FALSE-BLOCKS on a real, correctly-matched product, and it blocked today's publish (publish-deals-page.ps1 gates on match-soundness even though guards.ps1 does not). MECHANISM: the gate recovers the item a DROP verdict judged from the FIRST QUOTED STRING inside the verdict's free-text 'reason' (audit-match-soundness.ps1:200-203), ignoring the entry's own structured 'item' field, which current verdict files do carry. MEASUREMENT: the 2026-08-15 verdict judged item='Marketside Tandoori Style Garlic Naan Bites, 7.05 oz, 15 Count' on commodity garlic, and its reason reads "NAAN bread bites, not fresh garlic bulbs - 'Garlic' is a flavour descriptor...". The actually-judged naan bites are already honoured: suppressed by GLOBAL_EXCLUDE 'naan', carrying a known-wrong entry, and holding no cell. So the gate blocked a correct mapping and let nothing wrong through. IMPACT: any verdict whose reason quotes something other than the product name can permanently block -Accept on an innocent product, and the documented escape is -ForceAccept, which is exactly what the gate's own comment says must not become a habit. SUGGESTED FIX (not made here - a guard change to unblock my own publish is the conflict of interest this split exists to avoid): prefer $ve.item when present and fall back to the quote recovery, shipped with a must-fire fixture (a verdict whose item still maps to the commodity it was dropped from MUST still block) and a clean twin (this garlic row MUST NOT block).
